title: Breathwork Rescue-Session Frequency During Stress
dataSources: Mood entries (`daylio:entry`), CBT thought records (`cbt:record`), breathwork sessions (`breathwork:session`), and therapy homework items (`therapy:homework`).
app: Wellbeing journaling telemetry from Daylio exports, CBT thought records, breathwork apps, and therapy homework trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=breathwork:session
| search session_type="rescue"
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as sessions by _time stress_window
| sort - _time
description: Tracks rescue breathwork sessions during stress windows over time and breaks it out by stress window.
value: Rescue-session frequency shows when coping support is being used exactly where life feels most demanding.
implementation: Send rescue breathwork sessions during stress windows events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of rescue breathwork sessions during stress windows by stress window.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how rescue breathwork sessions during stress windows changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
